definitions.explanation: Eating excessively, beyond what is needed or healthy. Also used as a clinical term for binge eating in medical and psychological contexts.

examples.japanese: {過食|かしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Overeating is bad for your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{過食|かしょく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう。
examples.english: I end up overeating because of stress.

examples.japanese: {過食|かしょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{拒食|きょしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧{摂食障害|せっしょくしょうがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: I suffer from an eating disorder that cycles between binge eating and food refusal.

notes:
Compound of {過|か} (excess) + {食|しょく} (eating). Can be used casually for general overeating, but also functions as a clinical term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過食|かしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to overeat (⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb)
- {過食症|かしょくしょう} — binge eating disorder; bulimia
- {過食|かしょく}⟦{嘔吐|おうと}→嘔吐：08446_outo⟧ — binge-purge cycle
- {過食|かしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ — to turn to overeating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ→食べ過ぎ：28819_tabesugi⟧ — eating too much (everyday expression)
- ⟦{暴飲暴食|ぼういんぼうしょく}→暴飲暴食：08061_bouinboushoku⟧ — eating and drinking excessively
- {拒食|きょしょく} — food refusal, anorexia (opposite)
